entries.sourceGenerationPrompt: Create exactly ONE isolated removable biomask faithfully matching the official NECA Armored Combat Lost Predator Series11 edition photographed in FIRST image Lost4.jpg. Do not invent extra dangling hoses, wires, horns, teeth, vents, screws, glyphs, LED strips or rear/interior surfaces. The source details are limited; preserve visible mechanical relief without inventing micro-ornament. Source-like photographed product sculpture and paint, not a polished game-render upgrade yet. Compose a SQUARE native transparent canvas with the mask SMALL AND CENTERED, its longer dimension about75% of canvas size and at least10-12% clear transparent padding around every outer edge. Whole object, no clipping. Output exactly one isolated visible mask only, true alpha background, no labels, text, logo, frame, floor shadow, vignette, collage or additional view.
